records.text: George Zinn was arrested for claiming to be the shooter on the day of the shooting and was busted for child pornography on his phone
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: You remember the old man, George Zinn, arrested for claiming to be the shooter of the day of and then gets busted for CP on his phone.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 3326.033 quotes Viva Frei. The Utah County Sheriff's Office states that George Zinn was arrested after falsely claiming he shot Charlie Kirk and that investigators found more than 20 child sexual abuse images on his phone, leading to obstruction and exploitation allegations. Because criminal guilt had not yet been adjudicated in the cited release, this result verifies the arrest, discovery, and charges rather than a conviction.

records.text: David Freiheit said he did not know whether Tyler Robinson fired the gun but described broadly implicating, vague conspiracy theories as unsubstantiated and unfalsifiable.
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: I don't know if Tyler Robinson pulled the trigger. I don't know if he was on the roof and he was the one who fired the gun. ... But the insane conspiracy theories that are being floated that are implicating everyone and anyone involved that are unsubstantiated and unfalsifiable in their vagueness.

verification.notes: The primary episode includes David Freiheit's recorded voice saying he did not know whether Tyler Robinson pulled the trigger and describing broadly implicating theories as unsubstantiated and unfalsifiable in their vagueness. This directly verifies the attributed opinion.

records.text: David Freiheit said a more plausible alternative theory could be presented, but facts should not be manufactured without evidence.
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: But until you can provide the slightest shred of evidence other than I can divine an intention or a motive, you have to admit that from the evidence that you have right now, if you have a more plausible theory than the one being presented, which is Tyler Robinson was on the roof, took the shot, had the rifle, had the moment, had the opportunity. ... If you have a more plausible theory to present, you can go ahead and present it, but you don't get to manufacture facts out of whole cloth.

records.text: David Freiheit wrote that he agreed the pictured person did not look like Tyler Robinson but said the image appeared to be AI-enhanced.
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: I agree. The person in this picture does not look like Tyler Robinson at village crazy lady. ... But do you not understand that you are sharing what appears to be an AI enhanced photo from the original video evidence?

verification.notes: The source transcript contains Candace Owens reading David Freiheit's post: he agreed that the pictured person did not look like Tyler Robinson and then described the image as appearing AI-enhanced. A current news report independently reproduces both parts of Freiheit's post. This verifies what Freiheit wrote; it does not independently determine whether the image was AI-enhanced.

records.text: Viva Frei proposed that people in Tyler Robinson’s Discord environment or another outside influence may have helped radicalize or shape the assassination plot.
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: I want to know who was on the Discord chat in advance, what they were discussing, and whether or not there might have been some other foreign, I say foreign, not foreign government, but outer influence there.

verification.notes: Verified only as direct attribution of Frei’s theory. The clip supplies no evidence identifying an outside influencer or proving that Discord contacts radicalized or directed Robinson.

records.text: Viva Frei theorized that George Zinn learned of the plan through a Discord group and appeared at UVU as a useful decoy or distraction for Tyler Robinson.
records.speaker: David Freiheit

appearances.snippet: In my mind, if I'm making a plausible theory here, George Zinn was probably on some Discord chat with a bunch of young perverts and he's an old pervert and he's getting off doing whatever they do on those chats. ... He knows what's going down. He shows up there and thinks he's going to be some useful decoy or distraction for Tyler Robinson because they know what's going down.

verification.notes: Verified only as direct attribution of Frei’s expressly labeled theory. No reviewed evidence places Zinn and Robinson in a shared Discord group or shows that Zinn knew the plan.
